subject: Onboarding packet + provisional PO allocation for SableTech
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@sabletech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding packet + provisional PO allocation for SableTech

Hi Elena —

Thanks for agreeing to move forward with Redwood. To keep onboarding moving on our side we need a couple of things from SableTech so finance can issue a provisional PO and set initial spend caps:

1) Completed onboarding packet (vendor form + W-9 equivalent).
2) A line-item SKU map for the usage types you expect during the first 90 days (batch vs streaming, embeddings).
3) Confirmation of desired monthly spend cap for the trial (suggested: $50k) and any legal billing notes (PO reference, billing contact).

If you can return the packet and SKU CSV by EOD Wed (7/22) we can provisionally allocate a PO number and open a spend bucket so you can start integration testing Tuesday next week. Ive attached our onboarding checklist and a sample SKU mapping.

Also looping Grace (Finance) and Connor (Onboarding) to own the PO issuance and ledger routing. Grace — can you confirm the provisional PO workflow and whether we can split the initial cap across two line items (integration / compute)?

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Procurement Enablement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Elena Torres <elena@sabletech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet + provisional PO allocation for SableTech

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — attached is the completed onboarding packet and our SKU mapping. A couple of notes:

- We returned the signed vendor form and the W-9 equivalent as "SableTech_Onboarding_Packet.pdf".
- SKU mapping is in "SableTech_SKU_Mapping.csv"; we included three usage buckets (integration-testing, pilot-inference, embedding-index).
- For the trial period we prefer an initial monthly cap of $40,000. We can revisit after the 60-day pilot.
- Billing contact: Maya Patel (maya.patel@sabletech.com). Please include PO reference: ST-SBX-2026.

One question on your side: can the provisional PO be issued with separate line items for integration credits vs runtime consumption? Our finance team prefers separate tracking.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachment: SableTech_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (signed stub)
Attachment: SableTech_SKU_Mapping.csv (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding packet + provisional PO allocation for SableTech

Hannah / Connor —

Received Elena's packet. We can issue a provisional PO immediately but need to decide the ledger mapping:

Option A: Single PO 678092, two line items (Integration Credit - $10,000; Runtime Cap - $30,000) to match their request for separate tracking.
Option B: Two linked POs (678092A / 678092B) if they need completely separate invoice sequences. This is more manual to reconcile but doable for the trial.

Given they asked for $40k cap, I recommend Option A unless SableTech insists on separate PO numbers. Connor — can you confirm what their SKU csv maps to our billing categories? If integration-testing rows are clearly separable we can proceed with Option A and stitch the ledger entries.

Im also attaching a provisional PO PDF template (RHWD_provisional_PO_678092.pdf) which we can sign and send pending legal approval.

Cheers,
Grace

Attachment: RHWD_provisional_PO_678092.pdf (stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@sabletech.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Onboarding packet + provisional PO allocation for SableTech

Elena / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the SKU mapping and it cleanly maps to our three billing buckets. We're good to proceed with Option A. Next steps:

- I will request Finance to issue PO #678092 with two line items (Integration Credit - $10,000; Runtime Cap - $30,000) and set the monthly spend cap at $40,000 for the 60-day pilot.
- Please confirm Maya Patel as the billing contact and whether invoices should reference ST-SBX-2026 in the invoice memo.
- I'll send the provisional PO PDF to Elena and SableTech procurement for signature; legal will run a quick review but we don't expect delays.

Elena — attaching the provisional PO for your records. If you approve the line split, we'll route for signatures and open the spend bucket so tokens can be allocated to your integration project tomorrow.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Onboarding Lead, Customer Integrations
Redwood Inference
